# Historical GAP1 store witnesses

These synthetic stores were generated by the unchanged production page writer at
`0af1b55e3d586d4a6933098419e7ee46a7ae5a79`, with only the test capture patch
in this directory applied. The capture revision is `fc469ffe` (its first capture
revision failed to compile because a hook was placed in the wrong scenario;
no fixtures came from that revision). Run the three `verify_store` tests matching
`gap1_` with `BICDB_CAPTURE_HISTORICAL_GAP` set to a new empty output directory.
Compress each JSON with gzip level 9 and mtime 0. The manifest hashes the compressed
files; each JSON separately records every original store file's size and SHA-256.

Reader truth was collected by the historical engine opening disposable copies,
independently of the read-only verifier. Root witnesses also include those copies
after historical recovery and checkpoint. All 15 partial-drain steps are retained; the historical reader classified
all 15 as damaged. Original healthy-state conditional assertions remain in the test. The interleaved witness has 77 failing reads naming
page 340, with zero incorrect committed values. Source-generated rows contain
only deterministic test strings; these are not application databases.

The tests materialize these immutable bytes and preserve the original detection,
page attribution, count, and healthy-state assertions. Their existing snapshot
helper proves verification does not change file bytes, sizes, mtimes or listings.
Safe default writers must not need to recreate corruption for detection to be
tested. The separate live-writer recovery tests qualify prevention.
